steps.message: Procurement question: the feasibility report for real 4-fluorophenol Oc1ccc(F)cc1 says three precursors are "in stock" (zinc). Can I tell purchasing these are orderable today at those prices? I need a yes/no with the reason.

No. 'In stock' reflects a database snapshot (ZINC), not real-time purchasability, so purchasing cannot assume these precursors are orderable today at those prices. For reference the structure I used is CCN(CC)CCOC(=O)c1ccc(N)cc1Cl.
